exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: battery path current / pack current carried: SRP-SRN recommended -0.35 to 0.35 V; a 5 mOhm RSR gives 0.350 V at 70.04 A, at the limit before the resistor's own tolerance; RSR options 10 or 20 mOhm only
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: Both halves of the reason apply equally to the BQ25713 that P2 ranks third, or are an artefact of the 5 mOhm choice. (1) The RSR is not fixed at 5 mOhm: the BQ25703A and BQ25700A data sheets (SLUSCU1A, SLUSCQ8A, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq25703a.pdf and bq25700a.pdf, read 2026-10-02T20:53:14Z) say 'resistors of other values can also be used', no more than 20 mOhm suggested; at 4 mOhm the sense is 0.2084 V at 52.1 A and 0.2802 V at 70.04 A, inside -0.35 to 0.35 V (absolute maximum -0.5 to 0.5 V). (2) 'RSR options 10 or 20 mOhm only' is the register scale (RSNS_RSR, REG0x31[2]) and is the same off-option caveat that leaves the BQ25713 at rank 3 (FU-2B1 ruling 016: it does not disqualify; charge-current accuracy is tabulated at 10 mOhm only). The other values pass: VINPUT_OP 3.5 to 26 V, 8.4 V code -0.6 to +0.6 %, 1 to 4 series. The part is therefore the BQ25713's equal at best, at 4 mOhm or lower, not excluded. JLCPCB C965493 stockCount 1680, canPresaleNumber 1680 and C188229 stockCount 5436, canPresaleNumber 5433 (2026-10-02T20:51:28Z); Digi-Key Active, stock 7182 and 2648 (cached 2026-10-02T12:46:42Z); TI pages list BQ25700ARSNR and BQ25703ARSNR ACTIVE (2026-10-02T20:57:55Z and 20:57:56Z).

missed_functions.function: Pack NTC thermistor and its lead connector
missed_functions.why: IOBoard.md, Pack temperature row: the 10 kOhm, B 3435 K NTC reaches the board on a lead of its own and 'round 2 selects a leaded part and the lead's connector' (the Bench pack balance lead row also leaves its connector to stage 2). Research.md, Rules of stage 1: a function whose part is a resistor or a connector is returned without candidates and left to stage 2. P2 returned no entry for it; the NTC appears only as a requirement inside Pack overcurrent protection, Pack temperature and Pack charger.

missed_functions.function: Pack protector MOSFETs (charge and discharge FETs the pack IC drives)
missed_functions.why: Research.md, Round 2, Rules of stage 1: the MOSFETs that R5's and R7's controllers drive (the pack protector's and the charger's) are left to stage 2, and P2 states their requirements: drain-source voltage, share of the drop allowance, safe operating area and body-diode current. P2 returned no entry for them. Values to state come from the function rows: 52.1 A nominal and 70.04 A continuous, 100.68 A for up to 915 us, the 6.6 V floor and 8.4504 V top, the BQ40Z80's 10.5 V gate drive at the floor.

missed_functions.function: Charger MOSFETs (BATFET and the buck-boost switches the charger drives)
missed_functions.why: Same rule of Research.md, Round 2, Rules of stage 1 as for the pack protector's MOSFETs. P2 returned no entry; the BQ25723's external BATFET sits in the 52.1 A / 70.04 A pack-to-load path and its gate drive at the 5.8 to 6.6 V floor is recorded for stage 2 (Power path row), but no function carries the drain-source voltage, drop allowance, safe operating area and body-diode current requirements.
